title: Perfect Job Interview Prompts
description: Interview prep prompts for applications, confidence, and performance.
seoDescription: Use interview prompts to prepare STAR answers and role-specific responses.

prompts.title: STAR Answer Builder
prompts.text: Convert this experience into a STAR answer for [role]: [experience].

prompts.title: Mock Interview
prompts.text: Act as interviewer for [role] and ask me 12 progressive questions with feedback.

prompts.title: Behavioral Question Bank
prompts.text: List 25 behavioral interview questions for [role], grouped by competency.

prompts.title: Salary Negotiation Script
prompts.text: Write a professional salary negotiation script for an offer of [amount] targeting [target amount].

prompts.title: Post-Interview Follow-Up
prompts.text: Write a concise thank-you email after interviewing for [role] with one key highlight.

body:
Interview prep prompts for applications, confidence, and performance.

STAR Answer Builder

Turn experiences into structured answers.

Convert this experience into a STAR answer for [role]: [experience].

Mock Interview

Practice realistic interview flow.

Act as interviewer for [role] and ask me 12 progressive questions with feedback.

Behavioral Question Bank

Generate high-probability behavioral questions.

List 25 behavioral interview questions for [role], grouped by competency.

Salary Negotiation Script

Prepare negotiation messages.

Write a professional salary negotiation script for an offer of [amount] targeting [target amount].

Post-Interview Follow-Up

Craft thank-you and follow-up emails.

Write a concise thank-you email after interviewing for [role] with one key highlight.
